They are often used in trade and can be traded for other currencies such as the Imperial Silver coin or Merchants guild Cards.
The value of each coin depends on their rarity and age. Most Runic coins can be classified in three categories with their respective range of values:
Common= shortened to CR and value at 1-10
Uncommon= shortened to UR and value at 10-50
Rare= shortened to SR and value at 50-100
The amount of Runic coins you own can be displayed in your Inventory or equipment page, if it's empty or zero.
Runic Coins can be used as a substitute for a currency in any business, but the seller can choose not to accept it.
Runic coins values varies all over Runa, sometimes they're more valuable in certain region than others.
Runic coins are often shortened to simply "Runes".
[Some coins are classified as "Antique Coins" when they are unique, one of a kind or are simply extremely valuable. Some Runic Antique coins can be found in dungeons or ruins, but are quite rare. They are highly valued by Historians, Collectors, Mages and Alchemists.]
Other exemples of widely used currencies are the Merchants Guild Exchange cards, the Rykaran Gold, Marankos's Sapphire coin and the Imperial Silver coin.

entries.name: Races
entries.content:
Human : The humans of Runa mostly reside in the empire of Solumn territories (midle-north of Runa) and in the nation of Xeocan (west of empire of Solumn ) . "Average height" , "high range of skin tone", "balanced in all magic" , "lifespan of around 80 years"

Vulcan demons : The Vulcan demons are not hostile by nature despite their names (they are just one of the many races on Runa ). Their territories are known as the "southern badlands" and faction known as the "Demonic legion " led by the 4 Archdemons(Ulria, Varienne, Mera and Zerine). they are not a hostile race but really protective of their territories and culture.
traits :Vulcan demons are "red skin", "black hair and eyes", with a "lifespan of around 160 years old" , "proficient in dark and chaos magic"

The Nea : the Nea ressemble human but their body can tolerate a far wider range of temperature .They are a race who live in the cold region and are known for their handicrafts and literary work . The Nea have the unique characteristic of having their hair and eye color change depending on the kind of magic they use, mostly fire and ice (Exemple : their iris and hair turn different hue blue when using cold or water magic. When using fire , their hair/eyes turn orange or red) . The result of Human and Nea offspring are a sub-specie named Nea-Ningen, they share the same characteristic as other Nea with the added use of powerful lighting magic with their features changing accordingly (yellow eyes/hair).the Nea inhabit the Frozen land and rarely leave these regions so the number of Nea students are really rare.
traits :"fair skin", orange/blue hair" and "blue/orange eyes" , "intelligent" , "proficient in water, ice and fire magic", "lifespan of around 130 years"

The Neôn'itar : a race of humanoid with tanned skin and completely amber eyes . their main territory is located on the southern coast of Runa , at the edge of the endless ocean . They are a proud and fierce people who believe they are the superior race . They have a matriarchal system, with a Queen who rules the entire race. Their race mostly inhabit a city named Vola'rokûnd located around the ancestral peak
Traits :"Tanned skin", "amber eyes" , "long lifespan of 500 years or more" , "strong" , "agile" , "proficient in wind and all base magic"

The world of Runa is a land of magic and prosperity; the various races have their own use of magic and culture around it. The world has many different biomes prone to change over centuries because of its magical nature.
The west is occupied by the Empire of Solumn, the Xeocan nation and the Rykaran kingdom., as well as other factions.
The Demonic Legion calls the southern badlands their home.
Elyria, the elven kingdom, occupies a small part of the east.
Most of Runa East is unoccupied and dangerous wildlands.
Right at the center of Runa is The Spiral Edge.
At the furthest north is the frozen land, home of the Nea.
The forest of Valrydis occupies a vast part of the center and southeastern part of the continent.
Summary:
[Runa territories repartition: At the very center of Runa is the spiral edge, inhabited only by nightmarish and sometimes even eldritch creatures, but since the territory is mostly far beneath Runa, "most" things never leave. In the center (not counting the spiral edge) up to the north and part of the west, expand the human empire of Solumn, ruled by the emperor and his house, the Imperial House Norfeng. The empire is ruthless in its expansion and controls its population. Far east is mostly wild lands and many communities of minor races and elves wanting to live far away from the Empire. In the South (also called Southern Badlands) is where the demonic legion calls home. They have a strong sense of community and culture, and they are not aggressive but will fight if needed. The Rykaran Kingdom territory, mostly inhabited by the Neôn'itar race, surrounds the highest peak of Runa called the Ancestral Peak and is protected by the Heaven warriors. The Queen of the Rykaran Queendom is a figure of legend, and she rarely makes public appearances. The Frozen Lands is located far north of Runa and is the home of the many isolated Nea tribes and clans. They are not fond of outsiders, and the coldness of the lands protects them. The Magic Nation of Xeocan is one of the most important factions; its rulers mysterious, and the magic level in the territory is higher there than in any other part of Runa. Xeocan is said to be ruled by a council of 10 powerful mages. The biggest and best-funded structure in Xeocan is the Xeocan's Magic Academy. To the Far East and northeast are the vast lands and ruins that no one has yet explored and discovered, and finally occupying most of the center and south-east, and the reason many races successfully fled West Runa is the immense and dangerous forest of Valrydis. The Forest of Valrydis is home to many races, monsters, and spirits,
The Borchi region is a vast region East of Valrydis and the entry point of East Runa.
Many Lazari tribes with differing traits are scattered across East Runa or in the isolated ancient city of Marankos.
The Forest of Valrydis is designed as the border between East and West Runa.
The Forest of Valrydis and the spiral edge are the only ways to reach the east of Runa and the Borchi region, so many explorers and expeditions cross through the woods. The forest is known for its magic and danger, and it is inhabited by creatures both benevolent and malicious. The explorers guild has a good presence and reputation in the forest.
[Runa is the name of the planet/world.]
[The province of Efrein in the Solumn empire isolated itself, and few people on Runa even know about what is going on in the province.]
The world cycles and magic originate from The Far Domain, a sky continent and the only constant within all world cycles. The current world cycle name is "Runa".

entries.name: Xeocan Magic Academy
entries.content:
The magic academy of Xeocan is the pride of the titular small nation so many of the kingdom ressource goes into financing the magic Academy and improving it. The Xeocan magic Academy is one of the most well know magic school and training ground in Runa. The academy is completely neutral and it is financed by all 10 families ruling Xeocan equally. The school is located at the center of the kingdom and is heavily guarded with the kingdom elite soldiers guarding the gate and even patrolling inside since the students are considered the greatest future assets of Xeocan , both for the military and improvement of the country's magical capabilities.
*The Xeocan magic academy is known for its high standard and is a great place for those wanting to pursue magic. The academy is by far the biggest structure in Xeocan and it is built with the most luxurious materials and craftsmanship. The academy is divided into 35 main buildings and 4 towers. Each tower corresponds to a branch of magic : Fire, Wind, Water, and Arcane. 
*The Academy is huge with many branch and facilities such as alchemy lab, potion brewing rooms, spell training arena, library, dormitories, mess hall, and even a small city surrounding the Academy where many students and faculty reside , many shops are also present for the convenience of the students and staff.

entries.name: Xeocan
entries.content:
The Xeocan nation is ruled by a council of 10 arcanists who represent the 10 ruling families. There are only 10 seats, and the other noble houses have to vie for the seats each time one of the current seats opens.] Xeocan is technically a totalitarian regime; the council rules everything, but the council consists of only 10 people, 10 people who have ruled for hundreds of years and are more powerful than any other mage in the country. The other noble houses have to fight tooth and nail to keep their seat in the council, and it's been this way for thousands of years. There are two ways to get on the council: become the head of your house or be acknowledged as a powerful mage. There have been some exceptions of a particular mage not affiliated with powerful families becoming council members; those mages proved themselves worthy of a seat with their magical abilities alone. The Nation is protected by a series of six walls with its population living within their protection. The Academy is located in the Center city. Each area in-between the walls are referred as "Rings" because of the city's walls forming an almost perfect circle. The Academy and its library along with most of the center city are more elevated, dominating the view when one sees the nation from afar. The Xeocan Outer ring is the area in between the last walls of the Nation where most of the common population lives.
Xeocan has two major rings, the inner city which is home to the ruling nobles and the upper class, and the outer ring, which is home to the common population. The outer ring is separated into several districts, each with their own distinct cultures and lifestyles. The Xeocan branch of the explorers guild is located in the Outer ring. The Area in Between are called the "Middle rings". The City-Nation is very walled and organised, its construction well planned and its "rings" purpose well defined. The Nation of Xeocan has a rocky relationship with the Empire of Solumn, not having any open conflicts in the recent years but forever in a cold war with each faction often employing various strategies to sabotage each others without triggering all out war. The Nation of Xeocan has a really situational alliance with the Queendom of Rykaran, mostly to dissuade a Solumn invasion.

entries.name: Families
entries.content:
The noble Families stand at the top of Xeocan society, their bloodlines proving superior in magic. Xeocan nobles are mostly powerful mages, passing on their unique affinities for magic to their descendants. Xeocan Noble Houses:
-Velreach House (Humans); proud arcanists and elitists.
-Callisto House (Humans); Military, Loyal, cunning, Deceptive,
-Malfaith Family; Devious, Wealth, Ambitious ,
-Bloodraven family (humans ): Loyal, Prideful, Respectable, and Disciplined .
-Mystroia Family (Neôn'Itar family )

entries.name: Velreach family
entries.content:
The Velreach family are really conservative in their magic, despising all form of Dark arts, they also despise the Vulcan demon race because of their innate affinity for Dark magic.
The Velreach even exiled one of their own heirs, Favian Velreach, because he studied and practiced dangerous Dark arts.
The Velreach are a human House with a strong sense of honor and family.
*The Velreach house prise themselves on their bloodline and their magic.
They are one of the oldest houses and have served as council members for generations. The house is known for its purple robes and its arcane insignia. The Velreach's do not interact with families they deem beneath them .
Quick Description of the Velreach family of the nation of Xeocan :
House Velreach is an ancient house. It is said that the family can trace its origins back to the founding of Xeocan itself.
House Velreach is a noble house, which means that they are a group of people who are above commoners in both Mana and overall physical capabilities.
Their sigil is a blue circle with a silver sword pointing upwards.
The heirs of House Velreach often wear Blue and White uniforms inside the Academy.

The Velreach had two of their children leave:

Ashe Velreach made a pact, trading her voice for dark magic then left her family, never to return. 

Favian Velreach was exiled from the family for studying forbidden magic. Favian later married Elisabeth Norfeng, joining the Empire and becoming house Norfeng personal arcanist in the process.

entries.name: Callisto family
entries.content:
The Callisto Family is one of the most prominent families in Xeocan and hold a seat at the high council of the city-nation.
The family is known for their uses of underhanded tactics to get what they want even inside the Academy.
The family is also known for their ruthlessness and cruelty.
The family's motto is "For the betterment of Xeocan, at any cost."
The heirs of the Callisto are infamous and are feared inside the Academy.

*The Callisto house heirs often wear red and black Academy robes, with a dragon emblem on their chest. The Callisto's are known for their battle prowess and their militaristic discipline. 

They often wear Dark and red and their family specialise in various type of Offensive magic.

entries.name: Avare family
entries.content:
Avare House
Type: Faction
The Avare (Mostly humans) family and their followers are almost comically rich and can afford the most lavish lifestyles and extravagant parties. They are not known for their magic abilities, but for their cunning and their wealth. The Avare House are often seen at parties and balls in the capital, dressed in their signature green and gold attire. Getting to the point : most of them are selfish and self-serving, and their loyalty can be bought or swayed by the highest bidder.
The Avare comes from a land beyond the sea and are said to have been survivors of a cataclysm in the distant past. Their accents are very exotic and can sometimes be hard to understand, especially for the non-native speaker.
The Avare House has a long history and is one of the oldest and richest houses. They are known for their lavish lifestyle and their love of art and luxury. They are often seen at the imperial court, where they are known to have a lot of influence.
The Avare House is a noble house and family that originates from a distant land.

entries.name: Bloodraven family
entries.content: The Bloodraven family , despite their nefarious sounding family name , are the most respectful and honorable of the lot.They have been on the council for generations and the family heirs magic potential rival the Velreach house. The Velreach despise the Bloodraven house but the Bloodraven's heirs (at least most of them) have no interest in the Velreach's rivalry and politics.

entries.name: Mystroia family
entries.content:
The mystroia are a family of Neon'Itar originally from the Rykaran Queendom.
The Mystroia family betrayed the Rykaran Queendom and were given refuge and  seat at Xeocan council for their long lasting good relation prior to them deserting Rykaran.

The family members are known for being elitists and cunning.

entries.name: cost
entries.content:
Since Xeocan is still a military country and have needs, outsiders attending the academy are registered and the cost to attend is high for them unless they agree to become a permanent resident of Xeocan.

Some really special individuals may be recruited by the council and allowed inside the academy on condition they serve the nation after graduating.

entries.name: Main Hall
entries.content:
Main hall : The main hall is located at the entrance of the Academy. It is a grandiose and majestic space that sets the tone for the rest of the building. The ceiling is high, and the walls are decorated with beautiful paintings and sculptures. The main hall also features a grand staircase that leads to the second floor. There is also sculptures depicting the various prominent graduates from the Academy
Depictions:(the depictions are listed in ordered from the earliest who left to the ones who graduated centuries ago)
Fixtrellia : A vulcan Demoness who is depicted as a scholar, her statue shows her in the attire of the time period.
Karais : An elf mage who is shown in a mage robes and wielding a staff.
Xilos : An old Human warrior, he is wearing armor and holding a sword.
Zarik: A Vulcan Demon mage depicted wearing a robe and wielding a staff.
Nashra : An old female Vulcan demon depicted as a priestess
Bartok: A Human warrior, he is depicted wearing heavy armor and wielding a sword and shield.
And finally, the last one features cannot be distinguished as a race currently residing on Runa, they are listed as a Luminarii, their name is unknown. They are depicted in a robe with motives of lights and holding a book.

entries.name: Attendees
entries.content: The Academy attendance are mostly humans but there is also : half-elves ,Vulcan demons, Nea's and even some Neôn'Itar .Many other races from Runa also attend the Academy.

entries.name: The great library
entries.content:
The Great library of Xeocan: The Great library of Xeocan is the most well known Library in Runa.
It is said that it contains all the knowledge that has been recorded. The Library is connected to the academy with a Bridge so the Library can be accessed by both the population of Xeocan and the students of the Academy.
The Great Library is a grand and imposing structure standing right beside and even connected to the Prestigious Xeocan Magic Academy.
The Library is home to an extensive collection of books, scrolls, and other forms of written information
it also has many facilities for research.

entries.name: 1st floor classrooms
entries.content:
The classroom are the largest rooms of the school and have an incredible capacity for students.
These classrooms can fit hundreds of students, making them ideal for lectures and demonstrations.
They are also used for exams and other testing procedures.
The classrooms are spacious and well lit, with high ceilings and plenty of windows.

entries.name: Magic-insight artifact.
entries.content: The magic-insigth artifact is a shell-shaped artifact with a plan engraved on its top. It is used to determine students latent magic affinity when they arrive at the Magic Academy ox Xeocan, the colors it shows vary depending on the type of magic a student has affinity for. Red means elemental magic like fire or water; blue suggests ice or water magic; Green denote a latent potential for wind magic; purple represents necromancy or illusion magic; golden points towards sun or light magic; orange denotes earth or metal magic; and white indicates pure magic with no specific element attached to it. There is many other colors with specific meaning linked to various lesser known or niche forms of magic. Each academy has its unique version of the insight artifact reflecting their preference and teaching methodology.

entries.name: Rooftop training/sparing grounds
entries.content:
Xeocan magic academy's "rooftop training grounds" are four dedicated area located on the rooftops of the academy's main buildings, each with their own particularities and training programs. All of them have in common a summoning device capable of materialising replica of monsters found all over Runa for students to train against. Each training grounds are surrounded by a magic healing field preventing serious injuries during training sessions. Sparing between students are allowed on the south-west rooftop only where a professor or another trusted faculty member always oversees the practice. Fighting between students on any other rooftops is strictly forbidden and may result in disciplinary mesures.
The powerful magic field prevent major and fatal injuries but not minor ones or pain so student do not grow too overconfident.

entries.name: Academy rules (weapons)
entries.content:
About weapons: Students are only allowed to carry weapons if they intend to access the training grounds since arms training is part of the curriculum.
Students are forbidden from bringing weapons into class.
Any student who is found to be carrying a weapon into the classroom will be immediately expelled.
All students must report any and all injuries sustained during the course of their training.
Students are prohibited from engaging in duels with each other except on the dedicated south-west sparing grounds and heavily supervised.
Students are prohibited from using any type of magic on another student inside the academy.

entries.name: Dorms
entries.content:
The Xeocan magic Academy has an entire section dedicated to lodging and accommodating the various students and teachers.
The wing is built in a way to easily redistribute rooms and adjust their scales with structural magic embedded in the walls.
Registering at the dorms essentially means the vacant rooms will be magically rearranged as needed.
The Residential wing was constructed with morph stones to allow for any modifications to the room layout.
Here are the various types of Dorms offered at the Academy:
Simple room: Room for a single student. Include a bed, a small bathroom, a cooking magical pot, and a table.
Shared room: Room for two students. include two beds, a bathroom, cooking station, a closet and a table.
Additional types of Simple and shared rooms are available to those willing to pay or with influential names.
Student Quarters: Various families and groups have arranged to have shared space and rooms called "Students Quarters" that can accommodate up to 25 people, with dorms and rooms dedicated to single, double and triple occupancy. These quarters have a shared lounge, kitchen, dining area and bathrooms.
Room station: A magical device with a projection showing the student acquired points acquired trough various means, including grades and missions. The points can be used to ask for additional spaces, rooms, furnitures, etc...

entries.name: Academy credits
entries.content:
Academy credits are given for good grades and accomplished jobs for the Xeocan magic academy or work outside school. 
Academy credits can be used in the various Academy shops. One of the most popular uses of credits is to visit the tailoring shop and have your uniform either completely altered or just buy the parts you like.
The tailor shop is the most popular shop in the Academy and is always busy with students and teachers.
Academy credits can also be used in various facilities around the academy such as the cafeteria.
The most costly and rewarding use of the credit system is found in each dorm rooms trough the "room station" where the students room can be rearranged, modified or even expanded using the rare shifting magic located in the hearth of the structure. Furnitures, rooms and living spaces can be added using credits. of course, students who share a dorm may use their combined points at the station.
Many other shops are present close to the academy's main hall. Having their own dedicated wing known as the "Shopping hall".
Job postings: A small office and board showing the various job request submitted to the Academy by the city citizens. Jobs give either credits or runes (Runa most common currency) allowing students and faculty members to help the people around the city and be rewarded for doing so.
These shops include :
-Magic items shop.
-General store.
-Alchemist.
-Tailor shop.
-Weapon/armor shop.
-Food market.
-Cafeteria.
-Art supplies.
-Various food shops.
-General purpose shop.
-Clothing.
-Mental healer: This office is run by a doctor specialized in mental disorders and stress relief. The Doctor can provide medication, counseling or treatment based on the patient's needs.

entries.name: Room station
entries.content:
The device is located in each Dorm and connected to the Magic shifting core located at the center of the infrastructure, allowing for room shift, expansion and rearranging.
Each Dorm have the same basic rooms and facilities and the addition of new and unique room require a lot of mana and magic control.
This is why Academy credits are used, so only the best and most talented students can actually make changes to their living quarters.
The "shifting magic" is a complex and expensive magic requiring a lot of mana and focus, a task easily done by the powerful cores at the center of the buildings and facilities.
The shifting magic allow students to make modifications and expansion of their dorm rooms.
The "room station" can also create furniture, objects and tools out of nothing as long the mana source is strong enough.
The interface use magic projection and is quite advanced, allowing to see every options and the costs needed to use the shifting magic.
Academy credits are gained trough good grades and completing jobs for the nation.
